entities.summary: Gordon Thomas Lawrence Lane is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. He played in the National Hockey League for the Washington Capitals and New York Islanders from 1975 to 1986. With the Islanders, Lane won the Stanley Cup four times, from 1980 to 1983.
